crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, high-contrast white elliptical spot located on the posterior crown/nape boundary.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct and continuous; color transition between crown and mantle is seamless gray.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast transverse black and white barring on the tail feathers; small reddish-pink patch on the anterior crown/forehead.
